Context: Daily Allowance:

Widowed sister having an income exceeding minimum pension of {9,000 is also not included in the definition of 'Family' vide GIO (2), SR 2 (8).  
One additional fare for to and fro journey is allowed to the Government servant vide GIO (1) (VI), SR 116.  
Road mileage between residence and Railway Station is not admissible separately as the same are included in Composite Transfer Grant, which is paid at 80% of last month's basic pay.
